title: Investigating flaky tests
content: Official documentation summary, checked 2026-09-09. Katalon uses Probabilistic Flakiness Score (PFS), based on pass-to-fail transition patterns across execution history. Potentially flaky tests are visible in Test Case Health Analysis and test-run detail reports. Prioritize critical paths, high PFS scores and frequently executed cases. Review the historical result pattern before diagnosing the failure. The supplied CSV is_flaky flag is sample data; it is not a freshly calculated PFS score.

title: Inspecting TestOps execution artifacts
content: Official documentation summary, checked 2026-09-09. Open the project's Reports area, select a test run and use its Test Results tab to inspect individual outcomes. A result detail view contains execution information and linked defects. Execution evidence describes observed behavior in a specific run; it does not establish that every acceptance criterion is covered.

title: Confluence inherited view restrictions
content: Official documentation summary, checked 2026-09-09. Confluence content access depends on space permissions and content restrictions. View restrictions on parent content are inherited by children. A person who cannot view a parent cannot view its child content. An ingestion service must preserve effective permissions; copying a page into an index does not make the page public. This public documentation is not a connected enterprise Confluence page.

title: Slack conversation membership and scopes
content: Official documentation summary, checked 2026-09-09. Slack Conversations API scopes filter which conversations an application can access. Conversation membership can be fetched with the paginated conversations.members method. The ingestion principal's access must not be treated as every end user's access. Preserve channel membership or an approved access mapping when indexing discussions. No enterprise Slack messages are included in this corpus.
